knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Each claim needs evidence and a check against the advertising rules before publication.
A referral route is written with its terms and logging method, and any payment is checked before it is offered.
Tracking shows which channels return work at an acceptable cost, so the others can be stopped or changed.

practicalCriteria: Channel plan names the segment and reason for each channel
Each marketing claim is shown with evidence or removed
Referral route is written with terms and logging, and any payment is recorded with its source
Retention routine and review date are set
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Channel plan and enquiry log template
stopWorkCriteria: Testimonial invented or used without permission
Referral payment offered before its legal check
